when: every threat declared in the threat model has a mapped test
expect: each mapped test runs and passes

when: a real protection is removed from the application
expect: its mapped test fails, and passes again once the protection is restored

when: a declared threat has no mapped test
the threat source is empty or repeats a threat ID
expect: the flow ends in a setup error

when: the mapping from threats to tests is empty
expect: the flow cannot pass as an empty suite

when: an optional scanner is unavailable and project policy makes it required
expect: the check is reported skipped and required, and the flow exits non-zero

when: a scanner fails and prints output
expect: the check is reported failed and the raw output is not published
